List all the financial year available?
Based on the data retrieved from the database, the available financial years are FY2022-23, FY2023-24, FY2024-25, and FY2025-26.
Which account group has the highest number of accounts assigned?
Based on our analysis, the account group "Sundry Debtors for UFRESH - REAIL - RETAIL" has the highest number of accounts assigned, with a total of 561 accounts.
How many accounts were created each year?

According to our records, the number of accounts created each year is as follows: in 2022, 2678 accounts were created, in 2023, 476 accounts were created, and in 2024 and 2025, 356 and 347 accounts were created, respectively.
Which financial year has the largest total opening balance?
Based on the data, the financial year with the largest total opening balance is FY2025-26, with a balance of approximately 30,727,380.
